rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CLV Of Captivity or Imprisonment
rules.historical_meaning_only: The printed imprisonment chapter starts after divider lower original PDF676, separate from adversary-overcoming CLIIII.
The author proposes prediction of confinement/captivity, not friend counts or medical disease.
Sun and Moon are first-ranked source class for alleged confinement.
Saturn is part of second-ranked class, distinct from lights.
Mars is a separate member of the second-ranked malefic pair.
Seventh house is one third-ranked source of imprisonment testimony.
Twelfth house is also a third-ranked source alongside seventh.
Planets physically in seventh/twelfth add source testimony.
Saturn+twelfth are associated with prisons as a historic semantic category.
The same group is also associated with labor and secret opponents, not all imprisonment.
Mars is assigned overt dispute/open-enemy topics, different from arrest.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Either of Lights afflicted Saturn or Mars
rules.historical_meaning_only: One or other luminary is allegedly afflicted by malefics under the first case.
Square is an adverse aspect option in the compound.
Opposition is another allowed adverse contact.
The malefic should also occupy an angular location in the author's compound.
Additional natal house positions are claimed to modify the imprisonment case.
Lilly lists period sign group for one malefic condition; glyph-by-glyph degree not fully collated.
The source adds one malefic opposing one of the lights.
Another clause associates Leo/Cancer with a light under adverse opposition.
The combined circumstances allegedly imply confinement, unvalidated in actual cases.
A second case specifically places one luminary in twelfth.
Saturn bodily joining that light is one alleged captivity alternative.
Mars joining it, possibly with Saturn too, is another alternative.
The source qualifies the conjunct malefics as debilitated.
A second natal configuration allegedly signifies captivity rather than a tested case.
Mars's physical placement in seventh OR twelfth starts a further source case.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: in Aries Taurus Scorpio Capricorn Aquarius Leo Cancer
rules.historical_meaning_only: The source prints a multi-sign group of Mars placements, original glyph scope requires independent review.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: then afflicting by himself one Light
rules.historical_meaning_only: Direct affliction of a luminary by Mars is a further purported confinement factor.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: or Saturn afflict Sun or Moon
rules.historical_meaning_only: Saturn alternatively aspects/afflicts one of the lights.
An additional compound case is said to imply captivity again.
The traditional two malefics are required in a mutual aspect.
Square or opposition between them is one hostile alternative.
Conjunction is a third possible Saturn/Mars relation.
Their exaltation is stated as an exclusion or limitation.
Domicile can avert the claimed adverse inference.
Reception by benefics is another protective exclusion.
Reception by Sun or Moon also limits the negative case.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: either of them be onely Direct
rules.historical_meaning_only: An unusual source phrasing concerning direction is preserved without modern guess.
One malefic is claimed to have dignity at the relevant natal cusp.
The source supplies a group of arrest/custody/curtailed liberty alternatives.
Continuation from top PDF677 qualifies malefics opposing while in mutual dignities.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: one then first or second house
rules.historical_meaning_only: The source adds first or second house for one malefic at relevant time.
The other malefic is in seventh or eighth, not same house.
Twelfth ruler's role further qualifies source variant.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn Moon and Mars conjunction fourth
rules.historical_meaning_only: A source compound has Saturn, Moon and Mars together in the fourth house.
The fourth-house compound supposedly signifies captivity.
A second configuration uses Mars and Venus joined in eighth.

Benefic-looking sextile can ALSO count when Saturn is in sixth.
The source asserts permanent custody from this configuration, not measured sentence duration.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord twelfth essential dignity of Mars
rules.historical_meaning_only: A separate case puts the twelfth ruler in Mars's essential dignities.
That ruler must also occupy seventh under one source case.
Partile malefic affliction is an additional case criterion.
Combined twelfth-ruler case allegedly predicts confinement.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord ascendant and twelfth in conjunction
rules.historical_meaning_only: First and twelfth rulers conjunct provide yet another source variant.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: in fourth sixth eighth or twelfth
rules.historical_meaning_only: Four natal locations are offered as alternatives for ruler conjunction.
Ascendant ruler's malefic status changes predicted risk.
Retrograde condition is an alternative adverse source.
Combustion while angular is another explicit negative option.
An adverse aspect to twelfth ruler further modifies one branch.
Several preceding alternative branches lead to the same broad historical outcome.
Debility of the twelfth ruler is a source condition.
Malefic aspects to twelfth lord further condition the historical claim.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Saturn Sun Mars Moon Venus twelfth

Lord seventh in hard aspect to named planets completes source case.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: in any Sign except their own
rules.historical_meaning_only: The author exempts luminaries in their own domiciles.
Source prints Cancer, Leo and Taurus zodiac exceptions or qualifiers; exact grammar unresolved.

The author qualifies the otherwise forceful prediction as generally but not always.
Source uses a different condition if luminaries join in own dignity.
Strong malefic affliction overrides the presumed protection.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of Nativity under Sun beams tenth
rules.historical_meaning_only: The ruler under Sun's beams while in tenth is an unusual composite.
The original explicitly excludes two zodiac signs from this version.
Working for a king is an essential historical social context.

A separate malefic-Sun contact is asserted to change outcome to killing.

rules.source_anchor_not_diplomatic: he will be killed by them
rules.historical_meaning_only: The source alleges killing, not merely imprisonment; unverified and unsafe to apply.

Adverse planets opposing twelfth are duration-source candidates.
Strong malefics are said to prolong imprisonment.
Absence of beneficial restraint is further required.
The author alleges long-term custody without specific day/year threshold.
Helpful benefic aspects to twelfth form the countercondition.
The author alleges short confinement when the benefic condition applies.
